sources.role: Aging & Independence Services — APS written-report mailbox
sources.stated_purpose: Submission of completed SOC 341 after calling the APS hotline, as specified in the county guidance. Not general outreach.
sources.limitations: Verify current incumbent, mailbox and jurisdiction before use. Deliverability not tested. Do not send private records through ordinary outreach email. Restricted to the documented reporting procedure; do not use for bulk outreach. Retain hotline and online reporting routes.
